Contains every Material Symbols icon, so any name from https://fonts.google.com/icons works without re-downloading.
Filled icons and other weights are NOT available in this static file. If needed, replace it with the variable font
(variablefont/MaterialSymbolsOutlined[FILL,GRAD,opsz,wght].woff2 in github.com/google/material-design-icons, about 4 MB)
and update this file.

Do not edit the font. The @font-face rule and the .material-symbols-outlined class live in public/assets/css/icons.css.
To verify: sha256sum public/assets/vendor/material-symbols/MaterialSymbolsOutlined.woff2
